svg.title: Тяга с гирей от пола — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Conventional kettlebell deadlift from floor, three-quarter SIDE view. ONE kettlebell with bell-shaped body and one arched handle, placed on floor just IN FRONT OF toes, not in wide sumo stance, feet about hip-width. LEFT: hips back, modest knee bend, shoulders over bell, arms straight, both hands hold the single handle and bell base fully contacts floor. RIGHT: standing tall, bell hangs in both hands in front of upper thighs, arms straight. Bell is lifted clear of floor, feet stay at same place. No swing, high pull or barbell. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
